children: Shares of Quebecor were higher after reaching a 12-year sublicensing agreement with Rogers Communications for French-language broadcast rights to National Hockey league games.
Shares recently climbed 1.9% to 63.11 Canadian dollars ($45.75).
The Montreal-based telecommunications and media company late Thursday said that it will offer regular season NHL games on its TVA Sports and TVA Sports Direct channels.
Financial terms of the agreement weren't disclosed, but the contract will cover the 2026-2027 through 2037-2038 seasons.
Last year, Rogers and the NHL penned an C$11 billion 12-year agreement for the national media rights to NHL games on all platforms in Canada from the 2026-27 through the 2037-38 seasons.
